form: The long hall flooded with clear salt water and seen from a tiny swimmer's height: the bases of doors, stone reveals and the glass table legs rise out of the water like cliffs and columns; at the far end the floor flags climb out of the water as a step bank into grass

grows_from.waking_detail: the reedy river backwater beside the bank

amendment: BIB-0027 (user ruling 2026-09-22), applied p4-cr-architecture 2026-09-23: follows the parent's Art Nouveau redesign; swimmers other than Alice are photoreal CGI animals

mucha_design_language.item: Diff from SCN-long-hall at swimmer's height: the pastel-and-gold vine mosaic dado and the base of the cast-iron whiplash door frames and lily-stem columns fill the frame, their gilding shimmering in the water; stained-glass roundels are out of frame above; reflections of the mosaic ripple on the surface
mucha_design_language.why: At x12 the only visible band of the hall is its dado and door bases, so these carry the language

structure.item: the same hall, with water about four inches deep (true units) reaching half down the hall from the table end
the shore: at the south end the stone flags rise as three shallow broken steps out of the water, grass and reeds growing through their joints (the dream seam to SCN-pool-bank)
structure.note: step-bank design inferred; culture_ref geography.json#LOC-ornamental-pool adjacent LOC-pool-bank

materials.item: clear salt water, faintly green over the limestone floor, lamp reflections on the surface
a few reeds already standing in the water near the shore steps, and duckweed at the water edge along the wall bases
materials.why: The waking backwater bleeds into the flooded hall

details.item: the white kid gloves and large fan the White Rabbit dropped, floating
door bottoms, iron hinge ends, the feet of the whiplash iron door frames and wet dark tide-lines across the mosaic dado at water level
details.why: What a swimmer at this height sees of the hall

details.item: the glass table legs rising from the water like clear columns
details.note: table position from SCN-long-hall; the pool forms round the table end

interior.layout: north half of the hall under water; swimmers move south toward the shore steps at the far end; walls and doors frame both sides
openings: the 25 hall doors (closed, their lower thirds above the waterline)
no windows; the lamps overhead are far above and out of frame at this scale

scale_notes.anchor: Alice's effective height about 11 cm, so four inches of water reaches her chin (ch002-p16). Scale factor x12.

builds.beat: Alice swimming with the Mouse and the other creatures (photoreal CGI animals composited into the tank plates, SUP-002 as amended BIB-0027; their sizes relative to Alice set by 04-creatures)
builds.build: water tank 1.4 m deep with an oversized x12 band of the hall: flags 7.2 m, door bottoms, iron frames and the mosaic dado built up to 2 m above water, glass table legs 60 cm thick; everything above that band lost in darkness
x12: each step about 1.2 m rise, built as a real stone-faced ramp the performers climb out on

scale_notes.rule: Alice and the set share one scale; the hall shows her smallness (no VFX shrinking of Alice). The CGI animals are placed at their creature-sheet sizes against the x12 set.

negative: no open sea, no waves, no beach, no estuary
no daylight or sky above the water
no murky brown flood water; the water is clear
no cartoon animals, no humans in animal costume; the swimming animals are photoreal CGI animals
no Gothic pointed arches; no flat illustration finish
prompt_ready_en: a flooded Art Nouveau hall in the style of Mucha seen from water level, clear salt water with lamp reflections and rippling gold reflections of a pastel vine mosaic dado, the bases of horseshoe-arched oak doors in verdigris whiplash iron frames and pale limestone walls rising like cliffs on both sides, the legs of a solid glass table standing out of the water like columns, a white fan and white kid gloves floating, and at the far end broken stone steps climbing out of the water into reeds and grass
